note: Union County (GA) park on Lake Nottely, 13 mi N of Blairsville off GA 325 (Nottely Dam Rd). The recreation area has a swim beach, boat ramp, pavilion and fishing; beach and ramp need a $5-per-car parking pass. --Claude
summary: County page confirms 88 sites (camper + tent mix), power and water at most sites, dump, bathhouse with showers, open Apr 1 - Oct 15, reservations recommended (no online system shown). No rate anywhere official (only a 2024 Campendium user report of $30, not usable); amps not stated. Pin is at the entrance, ~200 m from the middle of the camper loops (OK). Note trimmed of field facts.
flags: FEES: no official rate exists online; the only figure is a Campendium user report ($30, 2024-04-04), which doesn't count because the county has a page. Fees stay unset - a call to 706-439-6103 would settle it.
SITES: 88 includes tent sites; the county gives no RV/tent split, so count stays the county's total. Campendium lists 20 A electric - unconfirmed, electric left unset.
BOOKING platform: the county page names no booking channel beyond the office phone; platform left unset rather than guessed as 'phone'.
WATERFRONT: imagery shows camper pads along the cove shore south of the entrance - consistent with the stored lakefront.
